page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d family. It features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 744.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with 16 local NVMe SSDs, providing high-speed local storage capabilities directly attached to the host.

With 192 dedicated vCPUs, this server represents a high-density compute configuration designed for parallel processing workloads. The lack of integrated GPU hardware means all computational tasks rely entirely on the x86_64 processor cores. The inclusion of 16 local NVMe SSDs offers high IOPS and low latency for temporary data storage, though users must manage data persistence externally as local SSD storage is ephemeral.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-standard-192-lssd consolidates massive compute power and high-speed local storage into a single virtual machine, reducing the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale databases, high-performance computing simulations, intensive build systems, and data-heavy enterprise applications that require high CPU throughput and fast local scratch space.
